text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — GateBridge + LangChain/LlamaIndex joint demo day. Target Wed Apr 14. Need alignment on tech scope, marketplace listing timing, and PR talking points. Anyone from integrations free for a quick sync?
Evan Patel: I can take tech lead for the adapter. What's the final API surface we want to show? streaming + tool-calls?
Liam O'Connor: streaming + function-calls yes. Also want to show fallback to a smaller model for cost SLOs. Can we prep a canary route for the demo?
Sophia Reyes: I'll own comms/marketplace assets. Need final build by Apr 4 to prep listing, screenshots, and a 30s promo clip.
Maria Chen: Evan, can you confirm sandbox image and creds? link: https://play.redwood.ai/sandbox — will need LangChain connector tests.
Evan Patel: Will push an adapter build to sandbox by Apr 2. TL;DR: supported features: streaming, function calls, reranking hooks. Minimal config I'm testing:
```
adapter:
  model: "gatebridge-redwood-v1"
  streaming: true
  function_calls: auto
  retry_policy: {max_retries:2}
```
Liam O'Connor: Add a KV cache warmup script too — demo needs fast first-token. Evan, can you add a `cache_warm=true` toggle?
Evan Patel: Yep. Will add flag and a small script. ETA Apr 1.
Sophia Reyes: For marketplace listing — do we need HW partner logos (NVIDIA/SigmaCloud) and verified perf numbers? Also need a short blurb: "Redwood + GateBridge: low-latency orchestration for multi-model pipelines."
Maria Chen: Yes. HW partner agreed to provide 99th percentile latency data. @integrations-bot can you schedule a runbook walkthrough with GateBridge/APIs?
integrations-bot: Meeting created: GateBridge demo-runbook — Apr 3 10:00 PT — invite sent to Maria Chen, Evan Patel, Liam O'Connor, Sophia Reyes (and gatebridge PM).
Liam O'Connor: Also align on evals — Sophia, can marketing handle a short 30s clip showing 2x lower latency vs baseline? :movie_camera: :rocket:
Sophia Reyes: We can. Need access to benchmark data and a stable demo script by Apr 4.
Evan Patel: Running perf harness tomorrow; will dump CSV into shared bucket: gs://redwood-partners/gatebridge-demo/perf.csv
Maria Chen: Ok blockers? any legal/privacy approvals for joint announcement?
Sophia Reyes: Legal signed off on the joint-blog template last week. Just need partner logo approvals and a short approval window from GateBridge PM.
Liam O'Connor: One more ask — orchestrator should show automatic fallback to LlamaIndex pipeline when Gateway overloaded. Evan, can you mock overload scenario?
Evan Patel: Will add simple fault-injection flag: `--inject-latency 800ms` to simulate spike. Also adding a tiny script to flip route to LlamaIndex for the canary.
Maria Chen: Great. Can we confirm final rehearsal date Apr 8?
All: +1
Sophia Reyes: I'll draft marketplace blurb, short FAQ, and a run-of-show. Will ping GateBridge PM for logo approvals today.
Maria Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the deck, PR checklist, and rehearsal agenda. Ping here for anything urgent.
